name: Tragic Elf Life
source:
Rebirths don't exist - at least that's what you always thought until you got caught yourself.
In the body of another, you are supposed to provide balance between non-humans, elves and humans.
This requires some charisma, but also the abilities you have been given by the divine being will certainly prove useful.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/tragic-elf-life-v0-03-straponcookie.157576/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
重生是不存在的——至少在你被抓住之前你一直这么认为。
在另一个人的身体里，你应该在非人类、精灵和人类之间提供平衡。
这需要一定的魅力，但神赋予你的能力也一定会很有用。​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/tragic-elf-life-v0-03-straponcookie.157576/]F95区[/url]]
